mentions.name: portsentry
mentions.description: A portscan detection and response tool originally released in 1997 and abandoned in 2003, adopted by its new maintainer in 2022 to add several needed features.
mentions.problem: The original tool was abandoned in 2003 and lacked several features the author needed as a long-time user.
mentions.source_excerpt: I work on portsentry (https://portsentry.xyz) - A portscan detection and response tool. It was first released in 1997 and abandoned in 2003. I’ve been a user for a long time but needed several features so I adopted the project in 2022.
